1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not comprise sodium hydroxide or other alkaline chemical solutions__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and does not comprise sodium hydroxide or other alkaline chemical solutions__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __in a single cycle or multiple repeated cycles__.

4. (Previously presented) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __in a single cycle or multiple repeated cycles__.

6. (Previously presented) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading__ enzyme __selected from cellulase, pectinase, or combinations thereof__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME® __or another cell wall degrading enzyme__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using a purification method comprising cold and heat treatment, heat and agitation, or enzymatic digestion__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and using magnetic separation__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at the globular, heart, or torpedo stage of development__.

12. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained from shed cellular material without destruction of embryo viability__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __using DNA template obtained directly from the shed cellular material__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA obtained from the shed cellular material__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __prior to germination, wherein the selection is based on molecular markers predictive of desired agronomic traits__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __to produce plants carrying the selected genotypes__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using robotic platforms or high-throughput genotyping systems__.
